title: Compare European descriptor field four in Steal menu
changes: Add an optional descriptor-bank field-4 assertion to the recorded-scene differential harness.
validation: One isolated Windows build and one Wine raw-versus-e99 comparison passed 280 retained frames, matching complete state, clock, video, OAM, dispatch and five audio outputs while reading 60 typed field-4 bytes.
limitations: Both arms shared a native cache; all-record and all-scene coverage, Linux, USA and native Windows remain unverified. No performance measurements.
